title: 统一证据谱系与真实原文定位
mode: DEVELOPMENT / FIXTURE. No LIVE provider call, no real device, and no formal case is signed here.

commands.note: run twice through the dispatcher on the committed tree; both reported 41 unique ids
re-run directly on the tree this report names

attempt_a.note: seven mutants, one reported survivor whose expectation was stale; the red list showed the correct id had already gone red

final.note: eight mutants, one per leg of every compound guard the card relies on; both halves of the snapshot currency/hash test are covered separately

mutation_matrix_note: one mutant per leg of a compound guard, learned from W08-01's round-1 review; whole-condition flips were what let six legs pass unasserted there. Anchors are taken from the delivered bytes and must occur exactly once, so a wrong anchor is reported as anchor-missing rather than as a kill or a survival.
not_verified_by_design: card action 4's Sirchmunk half: no field, state or adapter slot in the product represents a Sirchmunk qualification (sirchmunk_status exists only as a literal in ops/ci/retrieval.py), so only the local FTS5 baseline is asserted. Disclosed rather than invented.
LIVE_WINDOWS local-file retrieval (W09-02 / W09-G02) is not this card: no real-machine change/delete/fallback cycle is claimed here.
formal cases A06, C02 and C19 are touched as increments only; their signature belongs to W09-99.

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: the card's first draft binding plan was to point test.retrieval at ops/ci/retrieval.py; reading that runner showed it accepts only W09-G01/W09-G02 and C19/A06 and raises NOT_IMPLEMENTED for check_id W09-01, so the binding would have produced a refusal, not a PASS
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: wrote a v2.4 handler (tests/evidence/check/main.py) that serves only W09/W09-01 and reports the W0901-* roster it observes; the legacy runner is not bound by this card
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: 0 (the input changed with the fix; found by reading the delivered code)

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: the first matrix run reported N03 as SURVIVED with eight assertions red. That row's expectation was stale, written before the assertion it names existed: the compound guard `validity != CURRENT || content_hash != ref` is two decisions, and the roster only tested the hash half, so deleting the currency half could not kill the id the matrix expected. The red list was the evidence: W0901-CREATE-REFUSED-WHEN-SNAPSHOT-NOT-CURRENT was already in it
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: added that create-path currency assertion (it passes on the delivered code, so the refusal is real), split the mutant into N03 (currency leg) and N03b (hash leg) each expecting its own id, and re-ran the whole matrix on the final tree. Both passes are published: attempt_a is the run with the stale expectation, round1 is the 8-mutant run
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: one matrix re-run caused by a wrong expectation in the matrix, not by the code under test

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: adding the new assertion made the handler itself fail closed with unexpected_assertion_ids=[W0901-CREATE-...], because its expected roster is a literal list that must equal both the Go source's literals and what the tests emit
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: the id was added to EXPECTED_IDS and to the revocation group in the same change. This is reported as evidence, not as a nuisance: the roster guards are falsifiable in a way that a tautology would not be, and the reviewer is asked to judge exactly that
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: 0 (a guard doing its job is not a failure to retry)

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: the matrix driver's own clean-tree precondition was wrong: it labelled a green run 'survived' (no failures) and then refused to measure anything at all
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: run_handler now returns green/red/unexpected by report status and exit code instead of reusing the mutant vocabulary, and the same script was re-run to produce attempt_a and round1
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: 0 (tool fixed before it could report on the product)

scope_note: execution/v2.4/commands.json is outside this card's write_scope and was appended under the W07-01/W07-02/W08-01 precedent: one key added, the 22 pre-existing entries byte-identical, only check_id W09-01 claimed. internal/domain/retrieval.go, retrieval_local.go and sources.go are also outside the scope; they were edited only transiently by the mutation matrix and are restored to their captured digests, asserted per mutant.
